en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
"Whoever recites this verse before sleeping:
'Say, I am only a man like you, to whom it has been revealed that your God is One God' (Surah al-Kahf 18:110) until the end of the verse,
a light will shine for him to the Sacred Mosque (Masjid al-Haram), filled with angels who seek forgiveness for him until he awakens”.
